work.title: Toccata and Fugue in D minor, BWV 565

version.value: Orchestral transcription by Leopold Stokowski; first disc side only
version.note: Commons lists arranger “none”, but the LA Phil documents Stokowski’s transcription and its first recording in 1927. The original Bach work’s public-domain status is not a blanket clearance of every arrangement.

recording.value: Territorial — EU public-domain sound recording, first published 1927
recording.note: Accepted under programme rule 3: first publication before 1963, so the EU 50-year recording term expired before the 2013 extension. US status is not established. The Commons composition-only PD-old-70 tag is not used as a sound-recording licence.
